meta.title: A mock interview, turn by turn

views.label: Open the room
views.note: Consent and both caps are checked in one advisory-locked transaction before any row is written.

views.label: The turn loop
views.note: Nova owns the turn; the word gate owns the phase. Only accepted answers move the arc.

views.label: Wrap-up & scorecard
views.note: Held notes invite questions and the verdict; the scorecard is a tool call, never spoken.

segments.label: The turn loop · once per answer

messages.label: POST consent {version}
messages.note: POST /api/interview/consent sends the version string only; the server copies the college policy's storage scopes, and returns the standing row when nothing changed.

messages.label: WS ?specialization=
messages.note: Origin and the reep_session cookie are checked on the accepted socket, then the per-user limiter (4012) and the track lookup (unknown key: 4010).

messages.label: _open_records: consent · caps
messages.note: pg_advisory_xact_lock per student. No live consent: close 4013. Daily or attempt cap: close 4015. Otherwise INSERT interview_sessions (running).

messages.label: NovaSonicSession.run()
messages.note: Built with the turn writer, report writer, finalizer and heartbeat hooks, and the college's time limit.

messages.label: sessionStart + arc briefing
messages.note: InvokeModelWithBidirectionalStream over HTTP/2, SigV4 from the AWS chain. Persona + build_arc_briefing + the submit_scorecard tool; no student record.

messages.label: mic PCM16 · 24 kHz
messages.note: Binary frames on the same socket; recorded as captured only when all three audio switches are on.

messages.label: audioInput · 16 kHz
messages.note: Resampled from 24 kHz and sent base64 into the open USER audio content.

messages.label: completionStart · transcript
messages.note: Nova owns the turn: the ASR transcript is the first block of a reply it is already composing. Notes are held from here.

messages.label: accepted → phase tick
messages.note: Only accepted answers count: probing after 1, deep_dive after 3, wrap_up after 5. Filler, too_short, skipped and echo never advance.

messages.label: audioOutput … completionEnd
messages.note: The reply streams as audioOutput at 24 kHz; completionEnd closes the model turn and releases any held note.

messages.label: interviewer PCM · 24 kHz
messages.note: Forwarded as it arrives, in 40 ms chunks, with no resampling; response.done at completionEnd.

messages.label: turn writes · fire-and-forget
messages.note: Student and interviewer turns go to interview_turns + messages on a worker thread; a failure logs 'Dropped interview turn' and never ends the call.

messages.label: held note: invite → verdict
messages.note: [INTERVIEW CONTROL] notes wait for completionEnd. The watchdog forces the verdict at the effective cap (≤ 480 s − 20 s) minus 90 s.

messages.label: scorecard request note
messages.note: Sent only at the verdict's completionEnd: the student can no longer hear, plus REPORT_DIRECTIVE verbatim.

messages.label: toolUse submit_scorecard
messages.note: The arguments are the scorecard: never spoken, never written into the chat history, parsed by _parse_report.

messages.label: interview_evaluations row
messages.note: Awaited, not fired; nullable scores, and a row is written for every outcome.

messages.label: close row · turns emitted / persisted
messages.note: UPDATE … AND status = 'running', layer 1 of 3. Then the router closes the socket 1000 'Interview complete'.
